question: What claim about transmission is at stake in asserting that the teaching concerning the Mothers was again told by the sky-movers?
premises: A teaching concerning the Mothers exists.
It was told by the sky-movers.
inference: The teaching of the Mothers is transmitted again by the sky-movers to the addressee.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: Again, O goddess, O beloved, the teaching of the Mothers was told by the sky-movers.
